title: Eilat, HaDarom — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Eilat, HaDarom: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Eilat is a city in HaDarom with a population of 52,000. Israel’s southernmost resort city on the Red Sea, famous for its coral reefs, diving, and duty-free shopping. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 340 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
